voting_machines.reference: TSE report of incidents recorded up to 20:00 (Brasília) on 2026-10-25; voting closed at 17:00
notes: The percentage is over all 548,063 machines (in use plus backup), the same base as the TSE figure of 0.28% and as the first round. Over the 499,248 machines in use it would be 0.31%.
The TSE had released 1,516 replacements at 18:00; the 20:00 report adds 35 more.
The TSE term is "replaced" (substituídas). The TSE does not publish a count of "defective" machines.
Candidate percentages are over valid votes. Blank and null are over votes cast. Turnout and abstention are over the electorate.
